summary.tldr: Authorizes $20.48 billion in federal spending for the public service for 2023-24.
what_it_does: Authorizes payments to cover public service expenses for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2024.
Appropriates $20,478,605,110 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the public service of Canada.
summary.background: This is an appropriation act for the federal public administration for the 2023-24 fiscal year.
